subject: Matemática
description_pt: Classificar as frequências de uma variável contínua de uma pesquisa em classes, de modo que resumam os dados de maneira adequada para a tomada de decisões.

components.description_pt: Organizar dados de variável contínua de uma pesquisa estatística em intervalos de classe apropriados
components.description_en: Organize continuous variable data from a statistical survey into appropriate class intervals
components.cc_component_description: Organize and represent data with up to three categories

components.description_pt: Avaliar se o agrupamento de intervalo de classe escolhido sintetiza adequadamente os dados para tomada de decisão
components.description_en: Evaluate whether a chosen class interval grouping adequately summarizes the data for decision-making
components.cc_component_description: Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context by relating the choice of measures of variability to the shape of the data distribution and the context in which the data were gathered

cc_matches.description: *Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context, such as by* relating the choice of measures of center and variability to the shape of the data distribution and the context in which the data were gathered.

Organize, represent, and interpret data with up to three categories; ask and answer questions about the total number of data points, how many in each category, and how many more or less are in one category than in another.
